item.title: A retired Lebanese security officer vanishes and his family thinks it was a covert Israeli abduction
item.description: A retired Lebanese security officer vanished in December after going to meet a possible buyer for a plot of land. Lebanese officials and the family of retired General Security Directorate Capt. Ahmed Shukr believe he was abducted and spirited away to Israel in an intelligence operation.

item.title: UConn draws Princeton as CT’s women’s hockey teams get their NCAA Tournament assignments
item.description: UConn faces Princeton, Yale gets Minnesota-Duluth, Quinnipiac faces Franklin Pierce in the NCAA women's hockey tournament this week.

item.title: UConn men make Big East history as all-conference teams are announced. See who made it
item.description: The UConn men's basketball team became the first to have three players selected First Team All-Big East in league history as conference awards began to roll out Sunday.

item.title: International Women’s Day is a celebration and a call to action. Here are things to know
item.description: Women across the world will call for equal pay, reproductive rights, education, justice and decision-making jobs and celebrate progress toward female empowerment during events and demonstrations marking International Women’s Day on Sunday.

item.title: Pixar’s ‘Hoppers’ bounds to No. 1 as Warner Bros.’ ‘The Bride!’ is on life support
item.description: Disney and Pixar’s environmental adventure “Hoppers” topped the North American box office this weekend with $46 million in domestic ticket sales in its opening weekend, according to studio estimates Sunday.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball stars deliver to rout Creighton 100-51 in Big East Tournament semifinal
item.description: UConn women's basketball's trio of All-Big East selections powered a 100-51 rout of Creighton in the Big East Tournament semifinals Sunday.

item.title: Quinnipiac, Fairfield to meet in MAAC women’s tournament final
item.description: Fairfield, Quinnipiac women advance to MAAC tournament final.

item.title: Villanova beats Seton Hall in Big East Tournament semifinal to face UConn women for championship
item.description: UConn women's basketball will face Villanova in the Big East Championship for a third time in five years after the Wildcats beat Seton Hall.
